entities.summary: Hannah Bilka is an American professional ice hockey player for the Seattle Torrent of the Professional Women's Hockey League (PWHL) and member of the United States women's national ice hockey team. A native of Coppell, Texas, Bilka overcame the challenges of growing up in a non-traditional hockey market to become one of the top players in women's hockey. Bilka played college ice hockey at Boston College for four seasons (2019–2023), where she was named the Women's Hockey Commissioners Association National Rookie of the Year in 2020.
